Wait.title: Wait
Wait.description: Suspends execution until the given number of milliseconds has elapsed.

RandWait.title: Random Wait
RandWait.description: Waits a random duration in [min_ms, max_ms] (chosen once on open).

params.name: milliseconds
params.description: Fixed wait fallback when no range is given

Log.title: Log
Log.description: Prints an info string to the runtime log; always succeeds.

Repeater.title: Repeater
Repeater.description: Repeats its child until it returns RUNNING or ERROR, up to maxLoop times.

Limiter.title: Limiter
Limiter.description: Allows its child to run at most maxLoop times, then returns FAILURE.

MaxTime.title: Max Time
MaxTime.description: Returns FAILURE if its child runs longer than maxTime milliseconds.

params.name: maxTime
params.description: Max child execution time in ms

Probability.title: Probability
Probability.description: Runs its child with the configured probability, else returns skip_status.

params.name: skip_status
params.description: Status returned when the child is skipped

MailPull.title: Mail Pull
MailPull.description: Pulls mail via MailOp(MAIL_PULL) and stores the returned mail list on the blackboard.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of mails requested via MailOpArg.limit

params.name: log_detail
params.description: Whether to log pulled mail details

params.name: max_log
params.description: Max number of mail entries logged

outputs.label: mail_list
outputs.description: Mail entries returned from MailOpRes.mail_list; written to blackboard as mail_list

MailRead.title: Mail Read
MailRead.description: Reads unread mails from the blackboard mail list via MailOp(MAIL_READ).

inputs.label: mail_list
inputs.description: Reads each mail.uid from blackboard mail_list and sends it as MailOpArg.mail_uid

MailReward.title: Mail Reward
MailReward.description: Claims attachments from read mails in the blackboard mail list via MailOp(MAIL_REWARD).

inputs.label: mail_list
inputs.description: Reads eligible mail.uid values from blackboard mail_list and sends them as MailOpArg.mail_uid

MailDelete.title: Mail Delete
MailDelete.description: Deletes safe-to-delete mails from the blackboard mail list via MailOp(MAIL_DELETE), then clears mail_list.

inputs.label: mail_list
inputs.description: Reads deletable mail.uid values from blackboard mail_list and sends them as MailOpArg.mail_uid

FriendOp.title: Friend Operation
FriendOp.description: Performs an OpFriend operation on a set of role ids (explicit or from blackboard).

params.name: roleids
params.description: Explicit role IDs; falls back to blackboard friend_targets

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of targets to act on

inputs.label: roleids
inputs.description: Target role ids sent to OpFriendArg.roleids

RecommendFriend.title: Recommend Friend
RecommendFriend.description: Fetches recommended friends via RPC and stores them on the blackboard.

outputs.label: recommended_roleids
outputs.description: Role ids projected from RecommendFriendRes.roles[].roleid; written to blackboard as friend_targets
